# Acme Corp Code of Business Conduct and Ethics

## Workplace Professionalism and Harassment Prevention
Acme Corp is dedicated to maintaining a safe, inclusive, and professional workplace. Discrimination, harassment, bullying, and retaliatory conduct based on race, gender, sexual orientation, disability, or religion are strictly prohibited. All employees must complete annual anti-harassment training (60 minutes) by October 31. Violations of this policy will result in immediate disciplinary measures up to and including employment termination.

## Conflicts of Interest and Vendor Gift Limits
Employees must avoid situations where personal or financial relationships conflict with Acme Corp interests. Receiving gifts, meals, or entertainment from suppliers, contractors, or competitors exceeding $50 in estimated value is prohibited without written compliance approval. Gifts exceeding this threshold must be logged in the Compliance Gift Register within 7 business days.

## Whistleblower Protection and Reporting Hotlines
Suspected violations of law or corporate policy should be reported promptly. Acme maintains a strict non-retaliation policy for good-faith reports. Reports can be submitted 24/7 anonymously through the EthicsPoint hotline at 1-888-555-0177 or online at ethics.acmecorp.com.

title: Acme Corp Business Expense and Reimbursement Policy

# Acme Corp Business Expense and Reimbursement Policy

## Allowable Expenses and Per Diem Limits
Acme Corp reimburses reasonable and necessary business travel and operational expenses. Daily meal per diem is capped at $75 per day during authorized travel, allocated as $15 for breakfast, $25 for lunch, and $35 for dinner. Alcoholic beverages are non-reimbursable unless part of an authorized client entertainment dinner. Client entertainment expenses exceeding $150 per event require advance written approval from a department director prior to the event.

## Documentation and Submission Deadlines
All expense claims must be filed through Expensify within 30 calendar days of incurring the expense. Itemized receipts showing date, vendor name, item description, and payment method are mandatory for any expense exceeding $25. Credit card summary charge slips and bank statements are not acceptable documentation. Claims submitted after 60 calendar days from the transaction date are deemed untimely and will be rejected.

## Approval Hierarchy and Payment Schedule
Direct managers must review and approve expense reports within 5 business days of submission. Finance conducts secondary audits on all reports over $1,000 within 3 business days. Approved reimbursements are paid out bi-weekly on the 15th and final business day of each month via direct deposit.

# Acme Corp Health Insurance and Benefits FAQ

## Medical, Dental, and Vision Coverage
Acme Corp provides comprehensive medical coverage through Blue Shield PPO and Kaiser Permanente HMO. The company subsidizes 85% of employee monthly premiums and 75% of eligible dependent premiums. Dental insurance is administered through Delta Dental with a $2,500 annual maximum coverage limit per individual. Vision care is provided by VSP, featuring a $10 copayment for annual eye examinations and a $200 hardware frame allowance every 12 months.

text:

## HSA and FSA Contribution Limits
Employees enrolled in the high-deductible Blue Shield PPO qualify for a Health Savings Account (HSA). Acme contributes $1,000 annually for individual coverage or $2,000 for family coverage, paid out in quarterly installments on the first payroll of each quarter. Flexible Spending Accounts (Healthcare FSA) allow pre-tax contributions up to $3,200 annually, with a $640 rollover limit into the next calendar year.

## Open Enrollment and Qualifying Life Events
Annual Open Enrollment occurs from November 1 through November 21, with benefit elections taking effect on January 1. Changes outside Open Enrollment require a Qualifying Life Event (QLE), such as marriage, birth, or loss of existing coverage, and must be submitted via Workday within 30 calendar days of the event.

title: Acme Corp Information Security Incident Response Guide
text:
# Acme Corp Information Security Incident Response Guide

## Incident Severity Classifications and SLAs
Security incidents are classified into three distinct tiers. Severity 1 (Critical) involves active ransomware, credential theft affecting production infrastructure, or confirmed data exfiltration, requiring security response within 15 minutes. Severity 2 (High) covers compromised non-critical servers or active phishing campaigns with clicked payloads, carrying a 60-minute response SLA.

title: Acme Corp Information Security Incident Response Guide
text:
phishing campaigns with clicked payloads, carrying a 60-minute response SLA. Severity 3 (Medium/Low) includes lost encrypted hardware, suspicious spam, or minor policy breaches, with a 4-hour SLA.

## Immediate Containment Actions
If you suspect your computer or server has been compromised, take immediate containment steps: immediately disconnect the Ethernet cable and switch off Wi-Fi. Under no circumstances should you power down, reboot, or close open applications, as volatile system RAM contains vital forensic evidence.

title: Acme Corp Information Security Incident Response Guide

## Reporting Hotlines and War Room Protocol
Report all potential security anomalies immediately to the 24/7 SOC Emergency Hotline at +1-800-555-0911 or email security-alert@acmecorp.com.

text: SOC Emergency Hotline at +1-800-555-0911 or email security-alert@acmecorp.com. Updates are communicated to company leadership every 30 minutes during active outages.

# Acme Corp IT Password and VPN Access Guide

## Password Complexity and Lifecycle Requirements
All corporate Acme Corp domain accounts must adhere to strict password complexity standards. Passwords must be at least 14 characters in length and include at least one uppercase letter, one lowercase letter, one number, and one special character (!@#$%^&*). Passwords automatically expire every 90 days. The system remembers your previous 6 passwords, preventing reuse. Accounts are locked for 30 minutes after 5 consecutive incorrect login attempts.

title: Acme Corp IT Password and VPN Access Guide
text:

## Multi-Factor Authentication Setup
Multi-factor authentication (MFA) via Okta Verify is mandatory across all Acme enterprise applications. SMS-based authentication is restricted and only permitted as an emergency fallback by exception. New hires must configure Okta Verify push notifications on their corporate or personal mobile device within 24 hours of account activation. If you lose your registered MFA device, you must verify your identity via video call with IT support.

## GlobalProtect VPN Configuration and Support
Remote access to internal servers, code repositories, and databases requires an active connection via Palo Alto GlobalProtect VPN. Open the GlobalProtect client, set the portal address to vpn.acmecorp.com:443, and authenticate using your Okta credentials. Sessions automatically terminate after 8 hours of continuous connection or 30 minutes of idle time.

# Acme Corp Laptop and Hardware Provisioning Process

## Standard Hardware Profiles
Acme Corp provisions standardized hardware based on role specifications. Engineering, Product Design, and Data Science personnel receive an Apple MacBook Pro 16-inch (M3 Pro, 36GB RAM, 1TB SSD) or a Dell Precision 5680 (32GB RAM, 1TB SSD). All other departments receive an Apple MacBook Air 14-inch (16GB RAM, 512GB SSD) or a Lenovo ThinkPad T14 Gen 4 (16GB RAM, 512GB SSD). Peripheral bundles include one 27-inch 4K monitor and an ergonomic wireless keyboard and mouse.

## Ordering Workflow and Approval Levels

Custom hardware configurations or upgrades exceeding $2,500 require additional authorization from the department Vice President. Requests for secondary monitors or specialized accessories require Director sign-off.

title: Acme Corp Employee Leave and Time-Off Policy
text:
# Acme Corp Employee Leave and Time-Off Policy

## Paid Time Off Accrual and Rollover
Full-time Acme Corp employees accrue 20 days of Paid Time Off (PTO) per calendar year at the rate of 1.67 days per month worked. Part-time employees scheduled for at least 20 hours per week accrue PTO on a pro-rata basis. A maximum of 5 unused PTO days may be rolled over into the subsequent calendar year, but these rolled-over days must be used by March 31. Any remaining rolled-over days beyond this deadline, or unused days in excess of the 5-day rollover limit, are forfeited without cash payout.

## Sick and Bereavement Leave
Employees receive 10 paid sick days annually, credited on January 1. Sick leave does not roll over. If an employee is absent due to illness for more than 3 consecutive business days, a signed medical certificate from a licensed healthcare provider must be submitted to People Operations within 48 hours of return. Acme Corp also provides up to 5 consecutive paid business days for bereavement leave following the death of an immediate family member.

## Submission Deadlines and Approval Process
Planned vacation requests of 3 consecutive days or more must be submitted through Workday at least 14 calendar days in advance. Single-day time-off requests require at least 24 hours prior notice. In unforeseen emergencies, employees must notify their direct manager and email hr-benefits@acmecorp.com by 8:00 AM on the day of absence. Managers must review and approve all leave requests within 3 business days.

# Acme Corp New Employee Onboarding Checklist

## Pre-Arrival and Day 1 Milestones
New hires must activate their Acme Okta credentials by 9:00 AM EST on their designated start date. Virtual New Hire Orientation begins promptly at 10:30 AM EST via Zoom link provided in your welcome package. Under federal regulations, Section 2 of Form I-9 document verification must be completed within 72 hours (3 business days) of your first working day. Direct deposit instructions and tax withholding forms must be submitted in Workday by 5:00 PM on Day 1.

## Week 1 Training Requirements

Employees must also schedule introductory 1-on-1 meetings with their manager and designated onboarding buddy before Friday at 4:00 PM EST.

# Acme Corp Remote and Hybrid Work Policy

## Eligibility and Work Schedules
Full-time employees who have completed their initial 90-day probationary period are eligible for hybrid remote work upon manager approval. Eligible staff may work remotely up to 3 days per week, with Tuesday and Thursday designated as mandatory in-office collaboration days. All employees must maintain core working hours between 10:00 AM and 4:00 PM EST, regardless of work location, to facilitate cross-functional meetings and team availability.

## Equipment Stipend and Monthly Internet Allowance
Acme Corp provides a one-time home office setup stipend of $500, claimable within the first 30 days of employment for desk accessories, monitors, or ergonomic chairs. In addition, remote-eligible employees receive a recurring monthly internet reimbursement of $60, automatically credited via payroll on the 25th of each month. Receipts for the initial $500 stipend must be filed through Expensify under the "Home Office" expense category.

title: Acme Corp Corporate Travel and Entertainment Policy
text:
# Acme Corp Corporate Travel and Entertainment Policy

## Booking Procedures and Airfare Tiers
All business-related travel must be booked through Navan (formerly TripActions) at least 14 calendar days in advance for domestic travel and 21 calendar days for international travel. Economy class is standard for all flights under 6 continuous hours. Flights exceeding 6 hours qualify for Premium Economy, while continuous international flights exceeding 8 hours qualify for Business Class. Department Director approval is mandatory prior to ticketing any international itinerary.

## Lodging and Ground Transportation Rules
Hotel nightly room rates are capped at $250 per night in standard cities and $350 per night in designated high-cost metropolitan markets (New York, San Francisco, London, Tokyo, Zurich). Ride-share services (Uber, Lyft) are authorized for airport, hotel, and client site transit up to $65 per single trip. Personal vehicle usage for corporate travel is reimbursed at the federal IRS standard rate of $0.67 per mile.
